chart_sources.afford_strategy: QID19 — "What is the most effective strategy to improve housing affordability in HRE?"
chart_sources.afford_urgency: QID17 — "How would you rate the urgency of having affordable housing in HRE?"
chart_sources.anticipated_stay: QID47 — "How long do you anticipate continuing to live in your current house?"
chart_sources.asthma_pct: asthma — "How often does anyone in your home have asthma symptoms?" (Health input)
chart_sources.car_access: QID211 — "Do you (or your household) own or have regular access to a car?"
chart_sources.compare_street: mean Health, IAQ, Structural — aggregated per street (≥3 responses)
chart_sources.conditions: QID141 — "How would you describe the condition of your current house in terms of maintenance and repair?" (Structural input)
chart_sources.coord_source: derived from geocoding tier (Q212 → parcel match / fuzzy / Census) — data-quality metric
chart_sources.education: QID178 — "What is the highest level of education you have completed?"
chart_sources.employment: QID176 — "Which best describes your employment status?"
chart_sources.experiences_pct: QID124_1..10 matrix — % reporting each HRE experience (flooding, flood help, extreme heat, school change, law enforcement, insurance loss, well drying, pests, water leaks, loose animals). Likert 1–7; counts answers > scale-midpoint as positive.
chart_sources.hospital_pct: Hospital Respiratory — "Has anyone in your home visited a hospital for respiratory issues?" (Health +20)
chart_sources.housing_types: QID128 — "What type of house do you live in?" (Structural input)
chart_sources.hurricane_transport: QID219 — "During hurricanes/disasters, have you experienced transportation problems (e.g., difficulty evacuating)?"
chart_sources.interventions_pct: QID195_1..11 matrix — % wanting each home-resilience intervention (roof/walls, windows/doors, rain gardens, HVAC, plumbing/elec, well/septic, CCUA water, fence, trees-shade, trim trees, drainage). Likert 1–7; counts answers > scale-midpoint as positive.
chart_sources.match_rate: derived: % of community contacts upgraded by IAQ — data-quality metric
chart_sources.mean_health: composite Health: Headache + RespIll + asthma + wheeze + Tired (×weights) + Hospital Respiratory (+20)
chart_sources.mean_iaq: composite IAQ: Mold + Leakage 2_1..4 + Cooling System _1..4 + Cooking
chart_sources.mean_struct: composite Structural: QID192 (year built) + QID128 (housing type) + QID141 (condition)
chart_sources.mh_skirting: QID100 — "If you live in a mobile home, does your home have its skirting intact?"
chart_sources.mold_pct: Mold — "Evidence of mold in any area of the home?" (IAQ input, +30 pts)
chart_sources.ownership: Ownership — "What is your current housing ownership status?"
chart_sources.reloc_factors: QID181_1..8 matrix — relocation-factor importance (Employment / Affordability / Quality of Life / Family / Retirement / Environment / Inheritance / Other)
chart_sources.respiratory_pct: RespIll — "How often does anyone in your home have respiratory illness symptoms?" (Health input)
chart_sources.risk_by_street: composite overall_risk — aggregated per street (≥3 responses)
chart_sources.risk_tiers: derived from mean_risk — Low <34 / Medium 34–66 / High ≥67
chart_sources.safety_env: QID21 — "Do you feel safe in your house in terms of environmental threats (flooding, heatwaves, heavy rain/wind)?"
chart_sources.safety_social: QID194 — "Do you feel safe in your house in terms of social threats (loose pets, concerns about neighbors, etc.)?"
chart_sources.struct_by_street: composite QID192 + QID128 + QID141 — Structural score per street (≥3 responses)
chart_sources.symptoms: symptom prevalence: RespIll + asthma + wheeze + Mold + Hospital Respiratory
chart_sources.unmatched: derived: IAQ rows with no community-contact match — data-quality metric
chart_sources.wheeze_pct: wheeze — "How often does anyone in your home wheeze?" (Health input)
chart_sources.year_built: QID192 — "When was your house built?" (Structural input)
chart_sources.years_in_hre: QID12_TEXT — "How long have you lived in High Ridge Estates? (years)"
